bindings.variant: measure; CtcDecodeTrace stage split and SwipeSlotTrace, no placement probe

findings: Standalone and fused CTC run the same decoder object, ONNX session and lexicon; the only structural difference is the hop onto LibreBoardLiveSwipe. Across the six earlier GrapheneOS fusion runs fused_decode exceeded the same row's standalone CTC by 62–101 ms at p50, whether the preceding geometric scan ran 300 ms or 1500 ms.
Slot overhead is ruled out: queue 0.3 ms p50, slot plus ParallelSwipeDecoder 1.8 ms p50. A trie rebuild is ruled out: cache hits 97.0% standalone, 99.8% fused, trie stage 0.8 ms.

The gap is compute. Fused inference +13.8 ms and beam +33.5 ms at p50; fused CPU time 144.0 vs 106.2 ms for identical work, and fused cpu/wall 0.84 vs 0.97 (runnable but waiting for a core 16% of the time).
/proc schedstat showed the harness thread and the ONNX intra-op threads it spawned at nice −8 (AOSP Instrumentation) and LibreBoardLiveSwipe at nice 0, all in the /foreground cpuset 0–6.
A Perfetto sched/cpufreq capture returned no ftrace data on GrapheneOS; per-thread schedstat was used instead.
limitations: Diagnostic only; releaseEligible is false. The measure APK (non-debuggable, testOnly, ART speed) is not the pinned debugNoMinify APK, and the swipe model is a candidate, not the pinned model.
Swipe shard 1/3 of build/model-data/swipe-latin-v1/test.jsonl, first rows only; every run here replays the same row ids, so cross-run comparisons share rows but not device state.
Cross-run drift is about ±10% in CPU time (phone temperature 34–38 °C across the session); arm comparisons within one run are the reliable ones.

The instrumentation process runs in the /foreground cpuset (cores 0–6, no big core) and AOSP Instrumentation runs the harness thread at nice −8 (THREAD_PRIORITY_URGENT_DISPLAY). A visible IME may be scheduled differently; a live-keyboard measurement is still owed.
latencyMs times the suggestion call only, not end-to-end IME latency. Each row also runs standalone geometric (1500 ms budget) and standalone CTC before fused_swipe.
scope: Diagnostic 500-row GrapheneOS split of the fused_swipe CTC decode against the same row's standalone CTC.
